title: CandidateSet
description: The bounded set of candidates the scorer may rank (docs/architecture/decision-layer.md section 4). Every candidate was already authorised by the deterministic scope, authentication and permission checks before it is placed here: the scorer never sees, and never adds, anything else. The size is bounded (1 to 32 candidates) and the guard rejects an empty, oversized, stale, duplicate, cross-tenant or unauthorised set with the fallback reason candidate_set_rejected before the scorer runs. Duplicate candidate IDs cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are rejected by the guard. Candidate IDs are re-resolved by the deterministic application adapter before any use of a selection.

candidates.description: The authorised candidates, in the order the core built them. At least 1 and at most 32.

max_selections.description: How many candidates the scorer may select at most. Never more than the number of candidates; the guard rejects a result that selects more.

built_at.description: When the core built the set. A set older than the freshness window is stale and is rejected by the guard.

candidate.description: One authorised candidate: an opaque ID the application adapter can re-resolve and the minimum text the scorer needs to rank it. Candidate data comes from the host application through the deterministic adapter.

candidate_id.description: The host ID of the candidate (a capability, entity, action, dialogue act or path). Exact match only; there are no wildcards.

label.description: Short text identifying the candidate to the scorer, at most 256 characters.

text.description: Optional longer text that helps the scorer rank the candidate, at most 512 characters. Never unrestricted application data.

data_version.description: The host version of the candidate underlying data, compared for equality only, so the guard can reject a stale candidate.
